body:
## [3.115.0] - 2026-11-24

### Features

- harden remote diagnostic recovery
- interrupt active log recovery scans

### Bug Fixes

- honor recent log retry deadlines
- retain named invoice recipient on MQTT refresh (AION-952)
- deduplicate active command delivery
- preserve recovery interrupt priority
- close diagnostic recovery gaps
- preserve diagnostic queue priorities
- preserve diagnostic consistency and retries
- show named invoice recipient in customer section
- recover HTTPS cancellations during local replay
- preserve legacy phone split payment fingerprints
- preserve named invoice mode on customer changes
- avoid creating named invoice recipient partners
- require review for legacy order recovery
- address named invoice recovery and refund review (AION-952)
- retain loyalty member for named invoice refunds (AION-952)
- persist log scan cancellations
- make recovery cancellation durable
- bound historical log archive scans

### Other Changes

- Enhance invoice handling for customers by adding support for invoice recipients in cart and checkout processes
